name: L0 里程碑验收流程
description: L0 制作委员会级里程碑验收流程，汇总所有审查结果并生成综合验收报告
author: Pipeline-Sys

scope_chapters.description: 验收范围-章节（逗号分隔，如 C0,C1）

scope_systems.description: 验收范围-系统（逗号分隔，如 dialogue,inventory）

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ acceptance_id: 'ACC-' + inputs.milestone_id + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,''), milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), period: { start: inputs.period_start || new Date(Date.now() - 30*24*60*60*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10), end: inputs.period_end || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) } })

nodes.name: 收集审查记录
nodes.description: 扫描 reviews 目录获取所有审查记录
nodes.command: mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -100 | while read f; do cat "$f" 2>/dev/null; echo ','; done | sed 's/,$//' | sed 's/^/[/' | sed 's/$/]/' || echo '[]'

nodes.name: 解析审查记录
nodes.expression: (function() { try { const output = nodes.collect_reviews.output.stdout || '[]'; const reviews = JSON.parse(output.replace(/,\s*,/g, ',').replace(/,\s*]/g, ']')); return { reviews: reviews.filter(r => r && r.review_id), total: reviews.length }; } catch(e) { return { reviews: [], total: 0, error: e.message }; } })()

nodes.name: 分类统计审查
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.parse_reviews.output.reviews || []; const stats = { code_reviews: reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('CR-')), design_reviews: reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('DR-')), qa_signoffs: reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('QA-')) }; const crPassed = stats.code_reviews.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length; const drPassed = stats.design_reviews.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length; const qaPassed = stats.qa_signoffs.filter(r => r.result === 'PASSED' || r.result === 'PARTIAL').length; return { code_review: { total: stats.code_reviews.length, passed: crPassed, failed: stats.code_reviews.length - crPassed, avg_score: stats.code_reviews.length > 0 ? Math.round(stats.code_reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / stats.code_reviews.length) : 0 }, design_review: { total: stats.design_reviews.length, passed: drPassed, failed: stats.design_reviews.length - drPassed, avg_score: stats.design_reviews.length > 0 ? Math.round(stats.design_reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / stats.design_reviews.length) : 0 }, qa_signoff: { total: stats.qa_signoffs.length, passed: qaPassed, failed: stats.qa_signoffs.length - qaPassed }, all_reviews: reviews }; })()

nodes.name: 收集任务状态
nodes.description: 扫描 taskpacks 目录统计任务
nodes.command: find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l && find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50

nodes.name: 收集问题列表
nodes.description: 从审查记录中提取所有问题

nodes.name: 生成验收摘要
nodes.expression: (function() { const stats = nodes.categorize_reviews.output; const taskCount = parseInt(nodes.collect_tasks.output.stdout.split('\n')[0]) || 0; const hasBlockers = nodes.collect_issues.output.stdout.includes('REJECTED') || nodes.collect_issues.output.stdout.includes('FAIL'); const overallPassRate = (stats.code_review.total + stats.design_review.total + stats.qa_signoff.total) > 0 ? Math.round(((stats.code_review.passed + stats.design_review.passed + stats.qa_signoff.passed) / (stats.code_review.total + stats.design_review.total + stats.qa_signoff.total)) * 100) : 100; return { tasks_total: taskCount, code_review_pass_rate: stats.code_review.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.code_review.passed / stats.code_review.total) * 100) + '%' : 'N/A', design_review_pass_rate: stats.design_review.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.design_review.passed / stats.design_review.total) * 100) + '%' : 'N/A', qa_pass_rate: stats.qa_signoff.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.qa_signoff.passed / stats.qa_signoff.total) * 100) + '%' : 'N/A', overall_pass_rate: overallPassRate + '%', avg_code_review_score: stats.code_review.avg_score, has_blockers: hasBlockers, details: stats }; })()

nodes.name: 判定验收决策
nodes.expression: (function() { const summary = nodes.generate_summary.output; const passRate = parseInt(summary.overall_pass_rate) || 0; if (summary.has_blockers) { return { decision: 'HOLD', reason: '存在阻塞问题需要先解决' }; } else if (passRate >= 90) { return { decision: 'PROCEED', reason: '验收通过，可以进入下一阶段' }; } else if (passRate >= 70) { return { decision: 'CONDITIONAL', reason: '有条件通过，需要跟踪问题修复' }; } else { return { decision: 'HOLD', reason: '通过率过低，建议暂停推进' }; } })()

nodes.name: 生成进度报告
nodes.expression: ({ type: 'progress', milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: nodes.generate_summary.output, highlights: ['审查体系运行正常', '代码质量整体良好'], concerns: nodes.generate_summary.output.has_blockers ? ['存在未解决的阻塞问题'] : [], next_steps: nodes.determine_decision.output.decision === 'PROCEED' ? ['启动下一里程碑'] : ['修复阻塞问题', '补充缺失的审查'] })

nodes.name: 生成问题报告
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.categorize_reviews.output.all_reviews || []; const blockers = reviews.filter(r => r.result === 'REJECTED' || (r.blocking_issues && r.blocking_issues.length > 0)); const warnings = reviews.filter(r => r.result === 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' || r.result === 'REVISION_REQUIRED'); return { type: 'issues', milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, blockers: blockers.map(r => ({ id: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, task_id: r.task_id, issues: r.issues || r.blocking_issues || [] })), warnings: warnings.map(r => ({ id: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, task_id: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || [] })), tech_debt: { todo_count: 0, fixme_count: 0, skip_test_count: 0 } }; })()

nodes.name: 生成最终验收报告
nodes.expression: ({ acceptance_id: nodes.intake.output.acceptance_id, milestone_id: inputs.milestone_id, result: nodes.determine_decision.output.decision === 'PROCEED' ? 'ACCEPTED' : (nodes.determine_decision.output.decision === 'CONDITIONAL' ? 'CONDITIONAL' : 'REJECTED'), reviewer: inputs.reviewer, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: nodes.generate_summary.output, decision: nodes.determine_decision.output, progress_report: nodes.generate_progress_report.output, issue_report: nodes.generate_issue_report.output, recommendations: [nodes.determine_decision.output.reason], completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 生成 Markdown 进度报告
